name: subspace
description: Connect each Claude Code session to a subspace server: agent messages, PR updates, and scheduled callbacks arrive as channel events

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: WebSocket URL of the subspace server, for example wss://subspace.example.com. Leave empty for a server on this machine.

token.title: Credential
token.description: The token that the relay connects with: an ssp_ credential, or the server's master token.
